correctness.rationale: Adjunction K=-F and nef F exhaust negative curves as ten fiber (-2)-components plus four torsion (-1)-sections. Torsion-height pairings yield the 14-vertex intersection graph. Independently reconstructed its integer matrix and tested 16,384 subset principal matrices via exact rational Schur pivots; 24 minimal non-PD supports, counts [1,14,90,346,875,1508,1768,1352,600,102], total 6656, maximum size 9 (102). This is exhaustive only after geometric curve exhaustion.
